title: Pullback on actual hypercover cohomology
statement: For qcqs schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y, a Grothendieck abelian category A, sheaves F on Y and G on X, a coefficient map k:f*F→G and q≥0, construct the canonical morphism from the hypercover-cohomology colimit of F to that of G. Its component at U is base-change cohomology followed by k and the injection for the pulled-back hypercover.

proof.text: For each hypercover U, compose its base-change cohomology map, the coefficient map, and the target colimit injection. Refinement compatibility follows from naturality of the coefficient transformation and of the adjunction unit, and the colimit relation. These components define a cocone on the homotopy quotient: quotient morphisms are represented by refinements. Take its colimit descent. The universal colimit equation gives the component formula.
